$comment: Tracks the Modern Web Guidance catalog drift state for web-uplift. tests/mwg-drift-check.mjs maintains the lastCheck* fields across recurring upstream checks. analysedVersion and analysedAt describe the last full reanalysis and must move together with knowledge/mwg-catalog.json version and retrievedAt. lastAnchorCheck records that the rule-basis anchors were verified against the guide text of lastCheckUpstreamVersion (web-uplift-m9o3), which is a different fact from the version comparison. lastAnalysis records WHAT that reanalysis found (the catalog delta, the guide text changes it had to read, and what it did to the pins); a version bump with no lastAnalysis for it is a heartbeat, not an analysis, and tests/mwg-principles.test.mjs requires the two to agree (web-uplift-b1p5). Downstream mwg-train artefact fields (artifactId, catalogSha256, canonicalisation, appliedRulesVersion) define the versioned artefact contract (see docs/mwg-train-consumer-contract.md).
canonicalisation: json: recursive lexicographic key sort; array order preserved; compact (no insignificant whitespace); UTF-8; sha256 hex; object keys are emitted in JS property-enumeration order (integer-like keys sort ascending numeric, not lexicographic); tests/mwg-artefact.mjs is the normative implementation; non-ASCII characters are emitted as literal UTF-8, never as \uXXXX escapes (a serialiser that escapes them computes a different digest for the same catalog - the committed catalog contains U+2014; web-uplift-rxbh)

guideTextChanges.note: Comparing the 0.0.194 and 0.0.197 tarballs shows 13 added guides, 6 withdrawn guides (Temporal guides consolidated into capture-location-agnostic-data, calculate-event-differentials, and sort-high-precision-timestamps; dropdown/menu resilience split into viewport-aware-dropdowns and menu), and 62 modified existing guides including HTML-in-Canvas (<canvas content='drawable'>, captureElementImage, texElementSubImage2D), tiered clickjacking headers and regex nonce-stamping bans in security, Origin API validation in validate-origins, escape-html policy guidance in trusted-types, WebMCP framework hooks and schema-first descriptions in agentic-javascript-tools, and Long Animation Frames style/layout attribution in identify-inp-causes.

pins.ruleBasis: 2 of 16 anchors in knowledge/mwg-rule-basis.json broke against 0.0.197: secure-transport-and-headers-csp quoted the flat frame-ancestors 'self' directive block that 0.0.197 replaced with tiered framing policy (frame-ancestors 'none' default, 'self' for same-origin), and defensive-browser-policies-validate-origins quoted the example hostname trusted.example.com that 0.0.197 renamed to app.example.com alongside the Origin API. Re-anchored both rules to verbatim rule-stating sentences in 0.0.197, bumped catalogueVersion to 0.0.197, pinned the 0.0.197 anchor set in tests/mwg-rule-basis-anchors.mjs, and verified all 8 rules (16 anchors) pass --verify-basis against the 0.0.197 corpus.
pins.principles: Mapped all 13 added guides into knowledge/principles.json checks, removed all 6 withdrawn guide IDs (recording them in deadIds in tests/mwg-principles.test.mjs), updated check summaries for HTML-in-Canvas, Temporal, Subresource Integrity, Immediate UI sign-in, tiered clickjacking/CSP, and WebMCP framework hooks while preserving the 60-check denominator, bumped guidanceCatalogVersion to modern-web-guidance@0.0.197, and refreshed the catalogChecksum in examples/playground-report.json and examples/playground-report-fixed.json.

lastAnalysis.verdict: Substantive multi-release update from 0.0.194 to 0.0.197 (+13 guides, -6 withdrawn/consolidated guides, 62 modified guide bodies; net 187 -> 194 guides). Two rule-basis anchors were invalidated by upstream wording and example updates (security frame-ancestors tiering and validate-origins hostname example) without reversing any underlying rule; both were re-anchored to verbatim rule-stating prose and verified against the 0.0.197 corpus, and all 194 guides are covered in principles.json with zero dead IDs.

lastRulesRevision.reason: Re-anchored defensive-browser-policies-trusted-types from an example 0.0.194 rewrote to the sentence that states the rule; the rule itself is unchanged and the new anchor is verbatim in both 0.0.193 and 0.0.194 corpora (web-uplift-7bld)
